metadata.title: Lauschke, Tsiairis, Francois & Aulehla (2013) Nature — Scale-Invariant Phase-Gradient Encoding in Ex Vivo Monolayer Presomitic Mesoderm (mPSM)

sources.citation: Lauschke VM, Tsiairis CD, Francois P, Aulehla A (2013). Scaling of embryonic patterning based on phase-gradient encoding. Nature 493(7430):101-105.

Aulehla A, Wiegraebe W, Baubet V, Wahl MB, Deng C, Taketo M, Lewandoski M, Pourquie O (2008). A beta-catenin gradient links the clock and wavefront systems in mouse embryo segmentation. Nature Cell Biology 10(2):186-193.
Tsiairis CD, Aulehla A (2016). Self-organization of embryonic genetic oscillators into spatiotemporal wave patterns. Cell 164(4):656-667.
Beaupeux M, Francois P (2016). Positional information from oscillatory phase shifts: insights from in silico evolution. Physical Biology 13(3):036009.
Kuramoto Y (1984). Chemical Oscillations, Waves, and Turbulence. Springer Series in Synergetics 19, Berlin.
Dubrulle J, Pourquie O (2004). fgf8 mRNA decay establishes a gradient that couples axial elongation to patterning in the vertebrate embryo. Nature 427(6973):419-422.

mouse_mpsm_somites_specimen.species: Vertebrate paraxial mesoderm / somite embryo dorsal SEM (transferred as structural reference for mouse presomitic mesoderm and segmented somite periodicity)

lauschke_2013_governing_equations.section: Lauschke, Tsiairis, Francois & Aulehla (2013) Nature 493:101-105 Figs. 1-4
lauschke_2013_governing_equations.universal_phase_profile: phi(r, t) = omega_0 * t - Phi_0 * (r / R(t))^p,  0 <= r <= R(t),  Delta_phi_total = phi(0, t) - phi(R(t), t) = Phi_0 = 2*pi
lauschke_2013_governing_equations.local_phase_gradient_scaling: |dphi/dr| = Phi_0 / R(t)  =>  local wavelength lambda(t) = (2*pi / Phi_0) * R(t)
lauschke_2013_governing_equations.proportional_segment_scaling_law: S_n = alpha * R(t_n),  where alpha = 2*pi * delta_u / Phi_0 = 0.11
lauschke_2013_governing_equations.geometric_residual_radius_law: R(t_{n+1}) = R(t_n) - S_n = (1 - alpha) * R(t_n) = R_0 * (1 - alpha)^n
lauschke_2013_governing_equations.geometric_segment_sequence_law: S_n = alpha * R_0 * (1 - alpha)^(n - 1),  sum_{k=1}^N S_k = R_0 - R_N

canonical_mouse_mpsm_parameters.species: Mus musculus (E10.5 tailbud LuVeLu Lfng-Venus monolayer presomitic mesoderm explant)

pass3_mechanistic_parameters.section: Pass 3 (audit v3) extensions: FGF/Wnt-gradient-driven wavelength adaptation (Lauschke et al. 2013 Fig. 4; Aulehla et al. 2008; Beaupeux & Francois 2016; Dubrulle & Pourquie 2004) and the Tsiairis & Aulehla (2016) disordered cell-reaggregation lattice

fgf_wnt_signaling_gradient.source_sink_scaling: D W'' - k W = 0 on [0, R(t)], W(0) = W_0, W(R(t)) = 0  =>  W = W_0 sinh((R - r)/l_k) / sinh(R/l_k); for l_k = sqrt(D/k) >> R the profile is linear W_0 (1 - r/R) and l_half = R/2 (exponent d ln l_half / d ln R = 1)
fgf_wnt_signaling_gradient.fixed_length_exponential: W = W_0 exp(-r / l_k), l_half = l_k ln 2 independent of R(t) (exponent 0); mechanistic non-scaling control
fgf_wnt_signaling_gradient.note: The quasi-static approximation assumes the morphogen relaxation time (1/k, R^2/D) is short relative to T_osc = 140 min; the gradient is not time-integrated in the script.

wavelength_adaptation.equation: d lambda / dt = -(lambda - c_lambda * l_half(t)) / tau_lambda,  c_lambda = (2*pi/Phi_0) / (1/2),  Phi(t) = 2*pi R(t) / lambda(t)
wavelength_adaptation.segment_gating: S_n = R(t_n) [1 - (1 - delta_phi_seg / Phi(t_n))^(1/p)],  delta_phi_seg = Phi_0 [1 - (1 - alpha)^p] = 0.9144 rad

tsiairis_2016_reaggregate_lattice.equation: d theta_i/dt = omega_i + (K / n_i) sum_j [sin(theta_j - theta_i - a) + sin a],  omega_i = omega_0 (1 + eta xi_i)
tsiairis_2016_reaggregate_lattice.continuum_limit: theta_t = omega + D lap theta + beta |grad theta|^2, D = K cos(a) d^2/4, beta = K sin(a) d^2/4 (Kuramoto 1984); pacemaker frequency excess Delta omega = beta k^2
tsiairis_2016_reaggregate_lattice.pacemaker_detection: least-squares local phase gradient per cell; inward flux of the unit phase-lead vectors within rho = 30 um > 0.6 after non-maximum suppression (2 rho); cells with |grad theta| < 2e-3 rad/um carry no direction; neighbourhood coherence > 0.5 required
tsiairis_2016_reaggregate_lattice.qualitative_reference: Tsiairis & Aulehla (2016) Cell 164:656-667: dissociated, randomised PSM cells reaggregated in culture re-synchronise LuVeLu oscillations and self-organise multiple de novo wave foci (target patterns); the paper reports several foci per aggregate, not a fixed count, so the script's reference is the lower bound >= 2 and the single-dominant-pacemaker end state follows Kuramoto (1984).

lauschke_2013_explant_scaling_series.source: Lauschke, Tsiairis, Francois & Aulehla (2013) Nature 493:101-105 Figs. 2-4 (S_n vs residual mPSM radius R(t_n) across explant sizes)
